mode: Window-free egui, unit and lint checks only; no desktop/native-window or rendered-preview launches.

title_test.scope: Bound document filename and Untitled window-title formatting; draft destinations do not rename the document.

scope: Selection, Brushes, shape outline/fill, Rotate and Flip triggers now show hover feedback and an accent outline while open. AccessKit reports their expanded selection state. Shape paint choices use 220x40-point rows and selected outlines. Tests inspect actual egui frame shapes, hover/open/Escape transitions and document/history preservation, using light scale 1 and dark scale 2 with repeated layout passes. Existing fill/outline drawing test remains passing. Startup now lets eframe use PaintCraft as its initial title/application-menu name; document window titles remain host-published.
limits: No native macOS menu appearance or rendered reference parity is claimed. The launch-title fix is based on inspected eframe 0.37.0 AppTitleIconSetter behavior. Relaunch is required to pick up the startup change. Existing unavailable operations remain disabled, with no new engine semantics.
